title_s: Corrigendum to "Photometrically-corrected global infrared mosaics of Enceladus: New implications for its spectral diversity and geological activity" [Icarus 349 (2020) 113848]
abstract_s: The authors regret that the longitude grid in Figures. 9 and 11 was wrongly shifted by 180° in the original manuscript. We provide below the correct versions of Figures. 9 and 11.
